name: codequest-lab
description: A playful, mentor-driven platform for learning full-stack development.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @codequest/api" "npm run dev -w @codequest/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @codequest/api && npm run build -w @codequest/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @codequest/api && npm run lint -w @codequest/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @codequest/api && npm run typecheck -w @codequest/web && npm run typecheck -w @codequest/shared
